name: Lucknow–Kanpur Expressway
history: The Lucknow–Kanpur Expressway, also called the Awadh Expressway, is a 63 km road built by NHAI to replace one of Uttar Pradesh's busiest and slowest drives. Part of it runs on tall pillars above the old Lucknow–Kanpur road, and the rest is a new road through the countryside of Unnao district. It opened in July 2026, cutting the trip between the two cities to under an hour.
facts: Cuts the Lucknow–Kanpur drive from about 2.5 hours to roughly 45 minutes.
Begins with a long elevated stretch built above the old Lucknow–Kanpur highway near Lucknow.
